answer_text: The KB does not document a fixed numeric default for BGP Hold Time or keep-alive on a Cato site. It explains what Hold Time is and how keep-alive relates to it. When multiple BGP neighbors have different Hold Times, the effective Hold Time becomes the smaller of the configured values, and the keep-alive interval is adjusted accordingly (for example, if one neighbor has Hold Time 120 with keep-alive 40 and another has Hold Time 30, both use Hold Time 30 and the keep-alive is reduced to 10).
